description: This is the __init__.py file of a Flask backend application. It sets up the Flask app, configures CORS, loads environment variables, initializes an API with Flask-Smorest, and registers blueprints including a health check blueprint. It also attempts to initialize the database connection and handles potential initialization errors.

methods.name: load_dotenv
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if present.

methods.name: CORS
methods.description: Enables Cross-Origin Resource Sharing on the Flask app, allowing all origins.

methods.name: Api
methods.description: Creates an API object for the Flask app using Flask-Smorest.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database connection or models, imported from a relative module.

ctags.name: health_blp
ctags.pattern: /^from .routes.health import blp as health_blp  # noqa: E402$/
